scenarios.name: wscmb_pause_drec
scenarios.subject: Toad Town (preset toad), START opens the pause menu at frame 80, cold det start with the drec switch: the draw records of frames 140 and 141 go to shots/drec.txt.
scenarios.proves: WSCMB: the draw records of the pause menu windows (gPauseWS custom styles, src/pause/pause_styles.c) are a function of the build (det); base and row byte-equal when no draw changes.
scenarios.reason: WSCMB gate: drec in place of shots. Cold start, cap 30 s, deadline 25 s. The drec log line of the last frame is the until.
